name: rustly
description: Learn Rust in your browser: the Rust Book and the Tokio tutorial as short lessons with a live editor, real compiler errors and graded exercises. Built entirely in Rust (Leptos + WebAssembly, Rust API on Vercel).

paragraphs: Learn Rust in your browser. Rustly turns The Rust Programming Language and the Tokio tutorial into short lessons with runnable examples, a real code editor and graded exercises. You don't need to install anything.
features: Write real Rust. Every concept ends with an exercise in a full code editor (Monaco, the editor behind VS Code). ./run shows the output. As you type, compiler errors and warnings appear as squiggles at the right spot,…
Get graded. ./submit runs hidden tests against your code and shows which ones passed. Passing a checkpoint unlocks the next concept, and passing a chapter's challenge unlocks the next chapter.
Get unstuck. Hints appear one at a time, and the solution opens after three failed submits.
Keep your place. Progress, drafts and starred snippets are saved in your browser. Export / Import moves them to another browser.
Look things up. The snippet library lists every example from the lessons you've opened, searchable, with stars.
